pr_title: Fix name conflicts caused by the `SystemParam` and `WorldQuery` macros
pr_body:
# Objective

Fix #1727
Fix #8010

Meta types generated by the `SystemParam` and `WorldQuery` derive macros can conflict with user-defined types if they happen to have the same name.

## Solution

In order to check if an identifier would conflict with user-defined types, we can just search the original `TokenStream` passed to the macro to see if it contains the identifier (since the meta types are defined in an anonymous scope, it's only possible for them to conflict with the struct definition itself). When generating an identifier for meta types, we can simply check if it would conflict, and then add additional characters to the name until it no longer conflicts with anything.

The `WorldQuery` "Item" and read-only structs are a part of a module's public API, and thus it is intended for them to conflict with user-defined types.

issue_context.title: derive(SystemParam) fails when field type name is that struct's name + "State"
issue_context.body:
## Bevy version

785aad92

## What you did

```rust
#[derive(SystemParam)]
pub struct FooParam<'a> {
    state: Res<'a, FooParamState>,
}

struct FooParamState;
```

## What you expected to happen

Compile successfully.

## What actually happened

Got this error:

```
the name `FooParamState` is defined multiple times
`FooParamState` must be defined only once in the type namespace of this module
```

## Additional information

I'm pretty sure the bug is here:

https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/45b2db70705da24a89426e6b6e77d603a3983025/crates/bevy_ecs/macros/src/lib.rs#L374
comments: Yeah this is a product of us now defining a new type for the internal param state (which conflicts with your custom FooParamState). Maybe we should make the type name a bit more obscure. Or (ideally) sort out a way to not need a new type at all (ex: use tuples of the fields' states).  Although that would require rephrasing the traits a bit / might not even be possible :smile:
Oooh that one is new to me. Definitely worth a try.
This one is pretty old, so if you can't repro, I would assume it's been fixed.
Although the line of code I was concerned about remains: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/b9102b8836bd2aa07df2732f5364b9ac90accb66/crates/bevy_ecs/macros/src/lib.rs#L371

> Is this still a bug? Couldn't repro:

You are using MyParam as name instead of FooParam.

Yea it still reproduces for me on b9102b8836, but I also get this confusing error:

```rust
error[E0107]: this struct takes 0 generic arguments but 1 generic argument was supplied
  --> src/main.rs:4:10
   |
4  | #[derive(SystemParam)]
   |          ^^^^^^^^^^^- help: remove these generics
   |          |
   |          expected 0 generic arguments
```
